ideas.pitch: A rapid automated exploratory data analysis and feature engineering pipeline designed specifically for the 4-hour DataHeist CTF-to-ML bottleneck.
ideas.problem_statement: Crack a series of CTF-style challenges to uncover datasets, filter out intentionally bad/useless data, and build an effective predictive model.
ideas.title: CTF-ML Auto-Pipeline & Feature Filter
ideas.why_it_could_win: In a frantic 4-hour challenge combining CTF and ML, teams waste critical time manually inspecting decrypted data. An automated validator that flags noise vs signal using quick anomaly metrics gives an immediate competitive edge on the rolling leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight diagnostic script that rapidly detects and isolates poisoned, junk, or intentionally misleading decoy datasets unearthed during CTF extraction.
ideas.problem_statement: Not every dataset you uncover will be useful. Some datasets may be intentionally bad, while others contain the information needed to build an effective solution.
ideas.title: DecoyDetector: Adversarial Dataset Noise Filter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core twist of DataHeist—scoring dataset reliability before spending precious minutes training heavy models on corrupt or decoy data.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-fast model training framework optimized for tabular predictive modeling with automated cross-validation and rolling leaderboard submission formatting.
ideas.problem_statement: Analyze the available data, develop a predictive model, and generate predictions for the given real-world problem with rolling submissions.
ideas.title: RapidEnsemble: 4-Hour Tabular Booster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes rolling leaderboard iteration speed, allowing the team to test, validate, and submit predictions multiple times before the 4-hour clock runs out.

ideas.pitch: A quick integration utility that bridges CTF flag extraction scripts directly into clean tabular formatters for immediate model consumption.
ideas.problem_statement: Crack a set of CTF-style challenges to obtain the datasets needed for the modelling task and build a predictive model.
ideas.title: FlagToFeature: CTF Payload Extractor & Tabular Assembler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Eliminates manual file-parsing friction between the CTF puzzle-solving phase and the machine learning phase, saving critical minutes in a tight 4-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A local dashboard tracking model iteration performance, feature sets tried, and evaluation metric changes against local holdout sets during the 4-hour sprint.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams may submit their predictions throughout the 4-hour competition and track performance.
ideas.title: LeaderboardTracker Live Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Keeps the 1-3 person team organized under extreme time pressure, preventing duplicate or flawed model iterations from polluting final submissions.
